❯ Write a 600-word story about a lighthouse.

⏺ The Keeper's Last Winter

  Every evening at dusk, Agnes climbed the 117 iron steps of Gannet Point Lighthouse, wiped the salt from the lens, and
  lit the lamp. She had done it for thirty-one years, first beside her husband Tom and then alone after the sea took
  him. The light had never once failed, and she meant to keep it that way until the Board in the city found someone
  younger to replace her.
